title: Number Systems
description: Zero, and "the next one". From two rules, all of arithmetic. Unlocks the Peano Arithmetic Engine.

puzzle.goal: Starting from zero and the rule 'take the next one', add up the first n counting numbers. Write the sum forwards and backwards underneath itself, so that each term k is paired with its mirror partner, and express the total as half of a sum of those pairs.
puzzle.name: Gauss pairing (sum of the first n naturals)
puzzle.ask: Every pair adds up to n + 1, and there are n pairs. Find the sum of the first n naturals for the value given.
puzzle.method: Write the series once forwards and once backwards; the k-th terms of the two copies add to a constant. Two copies make twice the sum.
